title: Golden: Create a new appointment-based service
steps: Select Category: any UUID category from dropdown
expected: Dialog closes; toast 'Service created successfully'; new row appears in table with name 'PT Session 60', price 'RM 200.00', sessions 10

title: Golden: Edit an existing service
steps: Hover over an existing service row
Change the Name field to a new value
expected: Dialog closes; toast 'Service updated successfully'; row in table shows updated name

title: Golden: View service detail dialog
steps: Click anywhere on a service row (not checkbox/toggle/action buttons)
Wait for loading spinner to disappear
expected: ServiceDetailDialogA opens with two columns: Overview (status pill, type, recommended), Scheduling (type, duration, max attendees), Pricing (price, taxable, sessions, expiry), Timestamps

title: Golden: Deactivate service from detail dialog
steps: Open detail dialog for an active service
Confirmation dialog appears with service name
expected: Confirmation dialog closes; detail dialog closes; toast 'Service deactivated'; row in table shows as inactive (opacity-60 styling)

title: Golden: Toggle active inline (deactivate)
steps: Click the toggle switch in the Active column
expected: Toggle visually moves to off; toast 'Service deactivated'; row becomes semi-transparent (opacity-60)

title: Golden: Duplicate a service
steps: Hover an existing active service row
expected: Toast 'Service duplicated (inactive draft created)'; new row appears in table with name '{original} (Copy)', inactive state

title: Golden: Search filters service list
steps: Type a partial service name in the search input
expected: Table shows only rows where name or service_category_name contains the search string (case-insensitive); page resets to 1

title: Golden: Category pill filter
expected: Table shows only services in that category; page resets to 1; 'All' pill becomes inactive, selected pill becomes active (bg-[#0a0a0a])

title: Golden: Bulk enable selected services
expected: All selected services toggled to active; toast 'Selected services enabled'; selection cleared; list refetched

title: Golden: Sort by name ascending then descending
expected: First click: rows sorted A→Z; second click: rows sorted Z→A; sort arrow indicator changes from ↓ to ↑

title: Empty state: no services exist
steps: Navigate to the services tab with an org that has zero services
expected: Table renders with message 'No services yet. Create your first one.' in a full-width cell
selectorHints: getByText('No services yet. Create your first one.')

title: Empty state: filter matches no services
steps: Type a search term that matches no service name or category
expected: Table renders with message 'No services match this filter.'

title: Empty state: no organization selected
steps: Visit the tab when useUserContext returns no currentOrganizationId
expected: Page shows 'Select an organization to view services.' centered message; no table rendered
selectorHints: getByText('Select an organization to view services.')

title: Edge: Form submit with empty name
expected: Form does not submit; error message 'Service name is required' appears under Name field

title: Edge: Form submit with name over 200 characters
expected: Client-side validation fails with 'Name must be 200 characters or fewer'; form does not submit
selectorHints: getByText('Name must be 200 characters or fewer')

title: Edge: Form submit with categoryId not selected (empty string)
steps: Leave Category at 'Select a category' default
expected: Client-side Zod error 'Category is required' (uuid validation fails on empty string) under Category field

title: Edge: Form submit with Duration = 0
expected: Client-side validation fails with 'Duration must be at least 1 minute'
selectorHints: getByText('Duration must be at least 1 minute')

title: Edge: Form submit with Max Attendees = 0
expected: Client-side validation fails with 'Must have at least 1 attendee'

title: Edge: Taxable checked — Tax % field appears
expected: Tax % field is visible; entering 150 should trigger Zod error (max=100) on submit

title: Edge: Expirable checked — duration/unit fields appear
steps: Verify duration number + unit select appear
expected: Fields appear; on submit expiryDays is derived as 1 × 30 = 30

title: Edge: Time-preset scheduling requires at least one day
steps: Do NOT toggle any recurring day
expected: Client-side error 'Pick at least one day' from timePresetConfigSchema; form does not submit

title: Edge: Installment plan selected — interval and grace period appear
steps: Check a payment plan whose numInstallments > 1
Verify installment interval days and grace period fields appear
expected: Fields visible; grace period 90 accepted; on submit installmentIntervalDays and gracePeriodDays sent to API

title: Edge: Grace period > 90 rejected by server
steps: Submit a create/update service with gracePeriodDays = 91 (bypass client max=90 via devtools)
expected: Server returns BAD_REQUEST; toast shows server error message

title: Edge: Detail dialog for non-existent service ID
steps: Trigger detail dialog with a serviceId that does not exist in DB (e.g. by direct manipulation)
expected: StatusCallout with 'Service not found' error message is displayed in the dialog body

title: Edge: Duplicate service that does not exist
steps: Click 'Dupe' for a service whose ID was just deleted by another session
expected: Toast error with 'Service not found'

title: Error: Create service rejected — server BAD_REQUEST
steps: Submit the create form with a valid payload
expected: Toast error shows server message; dialog stays open (onSuccess not called)

title: Error: Create with invalid installment plan code
steps: Submit create form with availablePaymentPlans containing a code that is inactive/nonexistent
expected: Server returns BAD_REQUEST with message 'Unknown installment plan: {code}'; toast shows that message

title: Error: Active toggle fails
steps: Click active toggle on a service
expected: Toast error with server message; toggle visually reverts to original state

title: Error: User without service_management:create permission clicks 'New Service'
steps: Log in as a user who has service_management:read but NOT service_management:create
expected: Form submits but server returns FORBIDDEN; toast error; dialog stays open

title: Error: User without service_management:update clicks inline active toggle
steps: Log in as user with service_management:read only
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN; toast error message displayed

title: RBAC: Route redirects user without service_management:read
steps: Log in as user without service_management:read permission
expected: User is redirected to /dashboard?unauthorized=true; services page never renders

title: Edge: Pagination — next page
expected: Page 2 shown; 'Prev' button becomes enabled; table shows services 16-30

title: Edge: Pagination — Prev disabled on first page
expected: 'Prev' button has disabled attribute and cursor-not-allowed styling

title: Edge: Deactivate confirmation — Cancel does not deactivate
expected: Confirmation dialog closes; service remains active; detail dialog remains open; no API call made

title: Edge: Tab navigation — unknown tab param coerces to services
expected: ServicesPage renders (default tab); 'Services' pill is active

title: Edge: Header select-all then deselect on page change
steps: Select all items on page 1 using the header checkbox
expected: Header checkbox on page 2 is unchecked; items selected on page 1 remain in the selected Set but are not on current page; bulk bar still shows page-1 selection count

title: Gap: Bulk action partial failure not surfaced to user
steps: Select multiple services for bulk enable/disable
Arrange for 1 of N API calls to return FORBIDDEN
expected: Toast 'Selected services enabled' is shown REGARDLESS of partial failure; the failed service remains unchanged — user has no indication of partial failure

title: Gap: services.list query error shows as empty list
steps: Simulate a network error on the services.list API call (e.g. via devtools throttle)
expected: ACTUAL: TanStack Query puts the query in error state; the table shows 'No services yet. Create your first one.' (empty fallback rawServices=[]). DESIRED: an error state/message should be shown instead

title: Gap: Edit form opens with blank defaults if getById fails
steps: Have the getById API call fail (e.g. FORBIDDEN or NOT_FOUND)
expected: ACTUAL: editInitialData is undefined; ServiceFormDialogA opens with blank defaults; no error is shown to user. DESIRED: error toast or closed dialog

title: Gap: Detail dialog stale after edit
steps: Open detail dialog for service X
Click Edit on service X, change name, save
Immediately reopen detail dialog for service X
expected: Detail dialog re-fetches via imperative useEffect; new name is shown. BUT if edit dialog is closed and detail dialog was still open when edit saved, the detail dialog continues showing stale data until closed and reopened

title: Gap: Hub doc references TrainersTab but ServiceDetailDialogA has none
expected: No trainers tab exists in ServiceDetailDialogA; hub doc is stale on this point. serviceMembers.listForService and assign/remove are not called from this dialog

title: Edge: Dupe button disabled while mutation pending
steps: While mutation is in-flight, observe button state
expected: Dupe button has disabled attribute and opacity-40 styling; clicking again has no effect

title: Edge: deleteBranchPrice requires service_management:delete not update
steps: Log in as user with service_management:update but NOT service_management:delete
Try to delete a price override
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN; toast error; override not deleted

title: Edge: Service with no category — category filter does not include it
steps: Have a service with no category (categoryId=null)
expected: No extra pill for 'no category'; the service appears only under 'All'. Clicking any specific category pill hides it

title: Edge: Avg/month column shows dash for service with no sales
steps: View a newly created service with no sales orders
expected: Avg/mo cell shows '—' in muted text (text-[#a3a3a3])
